title: 1996 Topps The X-Files #60 Fresh Bones Episode Trading Card
descriptionText: The Topps 1996 The X-Files Trading Card #60 features the character Scully from the popular sci-fi TV show, The X-Files. This original non-sport trading card is part of the base set and was manufactured by Topps in the United States. The card is in English and showcases a standard size, making it a valuable addition to any collector's set of X-Files memorabilia.
